description: Two dozen amyls in a rattling little box. A brief, roaring rush.

overdose.message: One popper too many and your blood pressure bottoms out. You fold like a chair.

phases.comeup_message: A hot rush slams up the back of your neck and the room goes bright and loud.
phases.end_message: The rush drops out from under you as fast as it came.

name: Amyls
